description: Heatmap of WEE1/WEE2 pairwise identity showing F6TY09 in the WEE1 clade, separate from the WEE2 (female-pronucleus) clade
code:
import numpy as np, matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

labels=["eqWEE1_F6TY09","hWEE1_P30291","mWEE1_P47810","horseWEE2_A0A9L0SIB9","hWEE2_P0C1S8","mWEE2_Q66JT0","dmWEE1_P41847"]
M=np.array([
[100.0,95.4,90.1,50.4,52.0,50.6,52.1],
[95.4,100.0,90.6,49.9,51.7,51.0,52.1],
[90.1,90.6,100.0,49.8,51.5,50.5,51.3],
[50.4,49.9,49.8,100.0,82.7,70.3,51.7],
[52.0,51.7,51.5,82.7,100.0,68.3,50.0],
[50.6,51.0,50.5,70.3,68.3,100.0,49.6],
[52.1,52.1,51.3,51.7,50.0,49.6,100.0]])

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8,6.5))
im=ax.imshow(M,cmap="viridis",vmin=45,vmax=100)
ax.set_xticks(range(len(labels))); ax.set_yticks(range(len(labels)))
ax.set_xticklabels(labels,rotation=45,ha="right",fontsize=8)
ax.set_yticklabels(labels,fontsize=8)
for i in range(len(labels)):
    for j in range(len(labels)):
        ax.text(j,i,f"{M[i,j]:.0f}",ha="center",va="center",
                color="white" if M[i,j]<75 else "black",fontsize=8)
plt.colorbar(im,label="% identity (global NW)")
ax.set_title("WEE1 vs WEE2 pairwise identity\nF6TY09 (horse WEE1) groups with WEE1 clade (~90-95%),\nnot WEE2/female-pronucleus clade (~50%)",fontsize=9)
# draw clade boxes
import matplotlib.patches as patches
ax.add_patch(patches.Rectangle((-.5,-.5),3,3,fill=False,edgecolor="red",lw=2))     # WEE1 clade
ax.add_patch(patches.Rectangle((2.5,2.5),3,3,fill=False,edgecolor="orange",lw=2))  # WEE2 clade
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig("/tmp/wee_identity_heatmap.png",dpi=120)
print("Figure saved. WEE1 clade (red box) mean off-diag identity:",
      round(np.mean([95.4,90.1,90.6]),1),"%")
print("WEE2 clade (orange box) mean off-diag identity:",
      round(np.mean([82.7,70.3,68.3]),1),"%")
print("Cross-clade F6TY09 vs WEE2s: ", [50.4,52.0,50.6])
plt.show()
